title: A faster, conversion-focused retail experience
text: A modern storefront with streamlined product discovery and a responsive, mobile-first checkout journey.
overview: Mattressville is a premium mattress retailer serving the Greater Toronto Area from its Mississauga showroom, carrying world-class brands such as Stearns & Foster, Tempur-Pedic, Hypnos, Aireloom, Marshall and Kingsdown.
challenge: Buying a mattress is a considered, high-value purchase. Shoppers need to compare many brands, comfort levels and price points — and often want expert guidance before they decide — so the site had to make a large catalogue easy to explore and connect online browsing with the in-store experience.
solution: We built a storefront organised the way people actually shop for a mattress — by style, brand, budget, size and firmness — with rich product cards, a guided Mattress Matchmaker, flexible financing and clear delivery and guarantee messaging throughout.

features.title: Shop the way customers think
features.text: Mega-menu navigation by style, brand, budget, size and firmness, plus curated category collections.

features.title: Mattress Matchmaker
features.text: A quick online questionnaire, plus booking for in-store pressure-mapping, to guide shoppers to the right fit.

features.title: Decision-ready product cards
features.text: Firmness scale, ratings, price comparisons and live stock location on every product.

features.title: Financing & flexible payment
features.text: Affirm financing and multiple payment options to make premium purchases easier.

features.title: Delivery & guarantees up front
features.text: Free-shipping thresholds, white-glove delivery and comfort/price guarantees surfaced where they matter.

features.title: Support & engagement
features.text: Live chat help centre, customer reviews and a newsletter sign-up offer to keep shoppers engaged.

title: A digital presence that scales with the business
text: Strategy, design and development of a scalable web platform with a clear, conversion-ready structure.

overview: Inovexia Software is a digital solutions company that designs and builds websites, apps and software platforms for businesses around the world, alongside its own products — Examiner, an online proctored exam platform, and an accounting suite.
challenge: With a broad range of services and its own software products, Inovexia needed a site that could explain a lot without overwhelming visitors — presenting credibility, capabilities and products clearly, and guiding prospects towards a conversation.
solution: We designed and built a modern, structured platform: a bold hero with an animated technology-stack visual, clearly separated services and products, case studies, a transparent process and commitments section — with calls to action throughout.

features.title: Memorable first impression
features.text: A bold headline and animated “one stack” visual that communicates breadth at a glance.

features.title: Clear service architecture
features.text: Six core services — from e-commerce and app development to SEO and design — each clearly explained.

features.title: Product showcase
features.text: Dedicated sections for Inovexia’s own products, Examiner and the accounting software.

features.title: Process & commitments
features.text: A step-by-step development process and company commitments that build trust.

features.title: Light & dark themes
features.text: A theme toggle and polished UI details for a modern, comfortable reading experience.

features.title: Privacy-aware
features.text: Cookie consent and privacy controls built into the experience.

title: Turning manual workflows into software
text: A tailored internal system that replaced spreadsheets and email chains with automated, trackable workflows.
overview: Klej needed an internal system tailored to the way their team actually works.
challenge: Day-to-day work relied on spreadsheets and email chains, making it hard to track progress, share information and keep data consistent.
solution: We built a tailored internal system that replaced those manual steps with automated, trackable workflows, dashboards and integrations.

features.title: Automated workflows
features.text: Manual hand-offs replaced with automated, trackable steps.

features.title: Dashboards
features.text: Live visibility into work in progress and outcomes.

features.title: Integrations
features.text: Connected to the tools the team already uses.

title: An online store as handcrafted as the products
text: A characterful e-commerce site for a Toronto handmade soap maker — easy browsing across 17 collections, featured products and a story-led brand.
overview: Demo Soap is a Toronto-based maker of handmade soaps, crafted in small batches since 2004 — alongside bath bombs, shower steamers, soy candles, beard care, massage oils and more, sold in-store and online.
challenge: A wide range of small-batch products across many collections needed an online home that felt as personal as the shop itself — easy to browse, true to the brand, and simple to buy from on any device.
solution: We designed and built a playful, brand-led storefront: a striking hero, a swipeable carousel across 17 product collections, featured products, store and social sections, a blog and newsletter — with a smooth cart and checkout.

features.title: Brand-first design
features.text: Hand-drawn style typography and bold product photography that capture the handmade character.

features.title: Browse 17 collections
features.text: A swipeable collection carousel — from soaps and donuts to bath bombs, beard care and gifts.

features.title: Shop & cart
features.text: Featured products, add-to-bag, account and cart built for quick purchases.

features.title: Delivery offers up front
features.text: Free Toronto delivery over $45 and shipping across Canada & the US, shown site-wide.

features.title: Online meets in-store
features.text: Store location and social sections that connect online shoppers to the Toronto shop.

features.title: Content & community
features.text: A blog, Instagram link and newsletter sign-up to keep customers coming back.
